description: Python observability patterns for structured logging, metrics, tracing, and production debugging. Use when adding logging, implementing metrics collection, setting up tracing, propagating correlation IDs, debugging production systems, or building dashboards.
Instrument Python applications with structured logs, metrics, and traces. When something breaks in production, answer "what, where, and why" without deploying new code.

Emit logs as JSON with consistent fields for production environments. Machine-readable logs enable powerful queries and alerts. For local development, consider human-readable formats.

Keep metric label values bounded. Unbounded labels (like user IDs) explode storage costs.
